verification_note: The Most Populous county official results for the November 5, 2019 general election list Ginther 77096 (93.57%) and write-in totals of 5296. Within the write-ins, Jeff Leopard is the only named certified write-in candidate with 451 votes. The other 4845 write-in votes are not assigned to a certified candidate. Leopard is recorded as runner-up because he has the second-most votes among named candidates.
